valid:
run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj u1, u2 : User |
    some a : Photo |
    some d : Day {
        User = u1 + u2
        Influencer = none
        Photo = a
        Ad = a
        Day = d
        User <: follows = none->none
        User <: sees = u1->a
        User <: posts = u1->a
        User <: suggested = none->none
        Photo <: date = a->d
    }
} for exactly 2 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj u1, u2, u3 : User |
    some disj a, p : Photo |
    some d : Day {
        User = u1 + u2 + u3
        Influencer = u3
        Photo = a + p
        Ad = a
        Day = d
        User <: follows = u1->u3
        User <: sees = u1->a + u2->a + u1->p
        User <: posts = u2->a + u3->p
        User <: suggested = none->none
        Photo <: date = a->d + p->d
    }
} for exactly 3 User, exactly 2 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

previous:
run PositiveScenario3 {
    some disj a, b, c, d : User |
    some disj p1, p2 : Photo |
    some disj day1 : Day {
        User = a + b + c + d
        Influencer = none
        Photo = p1 + p2
        Ad = p2
        Day = day1
        User <: follows = a->b + b->c + c->a
        User <: sees = a->p2 + b->p2 + b->p1 + c->p2 + d->p2
        User <: posts = a->p1 + b->p2
        User <: suggested = a->c + b->a + c->b
        Photo <: date = p1->day1 + p2->day1
    }
} for exactly 4 User, exactly 2 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 1

valid:
run PositiveScenario3 {
    some disj r1, r2 : Worker | some disj c1, c2, m1 : Product {
        Workstation = begin
        begin = end
        Worker = r1 + r2
        Human = none
        Robot = r1 + r2
        Product = c1 + c2 + m1
        Component = c1 + c2
        Material = m1
        Dangerous = none
        Workstation <: workers = begin->r1 + begin->r2
        Workstation <: succ = none->none
        Product <: parts = c1->c2 + c2->c1
        Component <: workstation = c1->begin + c2->begin
    }
} for exactly 1 Workstation, exactly 2 Worker, exactly 3 Product expect 1

consistent:
run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj a, b, c : Track |
    some disj j1, j2 : Junction |
    some disj sm, sp : Signal {
        Track = a + b + c
        Junction = j1 + j2
        Entry = b
        Exit = c
        Signal = sm + sp
        Semaphore = sm
        Speed = sp
        Track <: succs = a->b + b->c
        Track <: signals = a->sm + c->sp
    }
} for exactly 3 Track, exactly 2 Junction, exactly 2 Signal expect 0

valid:
run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj p, q : Person |
    some disj c : Course |
    some disj r : Project |
    some disj g : Grade {
        Person = p + q
        Professor = p + q
        Student = q
        Course = c
        Project = r
        Grade = g
        Person <: teaches = p->c
        Person <: enrolled = q->c
        Person <: projects = q->r
        Course <: projects = c->r
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 2 Person, exactly 1 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0
